officialName.note: As registered with the UCI for 2026 (uci.org/team-details/21213, checked 23 Oct 2026). The site shows "name"; this is used in structured data as legalName.

uciCode.note: UCI team code for 2025 and 2026 (uci.org/team-details/21213 and the riders' UCI team history, checked 23 Oct 2026). It was MAW in 2022–2024. English Wikipedia (ATO) and the old site (MAV) are wrong. Re-check when the UCI publishes the 2027 registrations.

uciStatus.note: Confirm the 2027 registration category once the UCI publishes the list.

address.note: The address on the team's UCI and PZKol registrations (the title sponsor's office). Used in structured data only.

procyclingstats.note: ProCyclingStats has one page per season; update it for 2027.

uci.note: The UCI has one page per season; update it for 2027.
